column1: ## The SOURCE OF TRUTH for names.  tools/transpile.py reads this; never hand-rename in
## generated files.  Grows over time — append as understanding arrives.
## is_hw: 1 for a BBC I/O address ($FC00-$FEFF) or an OS vector cell ($0200-$0235)
## ⚠ On a binary-only project the names ARE the map.  Do one concentrated
## rough-but-directionally-correct naming pass early (docs/phases.md Phase 2.4) rather than
## letting names trickle in — every wrong name taxes every later reasoning step.
## A name that contradicts behaviour goes in docs/rename.md the moment you notice it.
